CustomField.description: Lets users edit values directly in the grid and save them, and use Edit and Change Owner in each row's menu. Only columns marked Editable can be edited, and users need edit access to each field and record.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Select to let users edit and save values in the grid's Editable columns, and use Edit and Change Owner in a row's menu.
CustomField.label: Allow Inline Edit
